title: functions/<id>/index.json
description: A function: a named, sealed sub-workflow with typed inputs, its body listed in nodes and one returned node.

label.description: The display name of the function; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the function).

label.description: The display name of the parameter, shown in the Editor and History; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the parameter).

format.description: The parameter's type: a format name or an inline schema.

inputs.description: The parameters keyed by id, in written order; {} for none. Every parameter is required at a call.

snippets.description: The package's snippets the function uses, by id; [] for none.

macros.description: The package's macros the function uses, by id; [] for none.

formats.description: The package's formats the function uses, by id; [] for none.

renderers.description: The package's renderers the function uses, by id; [] for none.

uses.description: The package definitions the function uses and so lists.

nodes.description: The function's top-level body, in order: at least one id, each once.

ret.description: The body node the function returns, counted from the function's root.

format.description: The function's result type, equal to its ret's format: a format name or an inline schema.
